title: A Strange Night With The 1-800 Club

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have encountered a specific Mall World space and the '1-800 Club' group

locations.location_name: odd corner / space between retail locations

qualities.raw_description: “one of those odd corners of The Mall World… a space that seemed to exist between the usual retail locations”

position.relative_to: within an odd corner/space between retail locations

qualities.raw_description: Intimate/disorienting rectangular gathering space; continuous booth-couch wrapping entirely around walls; deep vinyl upholstery reflecting light; rope light continuously along back of seating casting “deep, pulsing crimson glow”; red light “breathe”/rippling; scattered blacklights creating “impossible purple” patches; vinyl looked almost liquid; large central table with glowing glass pipes and ornate bongs; smoke forming ephemeral sculptures in crimson-tinted atmosphere; members produced Erlenmeyer flasks from beneath booth-couch.

position.relative_to: through another door from the red-lit booth room

qualities.raw_description: “vast open space” with ceiling that “soared away into darkness” (impression of infinite height); dominated by enormous ~15-foot puppet figures behind oversized synthesizers; theatrical lighting with ultraviolet elements revealing phosphorescent paint; audience includes adults and children; children moved close to the stage.

connections.qualities: Dreamer entered the first room within a space between retail locations (no specific doorway described).
“another door—one that seemed to appear in the wall rather than having been there all along” leading into a converted theater; transition described as “jarring.”

interactions.description: Observed members of the “1-800 Club” (about 8–10 people) seated around the booth-couch, interacting with familiarity; passing glowing pipes/bongs with practiced grace; smoke caught layered lighting creating ephemeral shapes.

entities_involved.description: Members of the “1-800 Club,” ~8–10 people; choreographed/practiced interactions; each seemed to have a preferred piece.

interactions.description: Observed a large central table covered with smoking apparatus: glass pipes and ornate bongs designed to react to blacklight; pieces glowed transparent purple with neon accents and complex patterns; some simple, others elaborate multi-chamber sculptures.

Members produced Erlenmeyer flasks from beneath the booth-couch containing clear liquid and floating organic entities; each flask topped with a long, sharp, mirror-finish probe; members selected a creature, speared it, and pressed the living substance into their skin; dreamer received a flask, examined it closely, and passed/refused to participate (only one to refuse).

entities_involved.description: Club members performing a repeated selection/spearing/skin-application procedure with precision and ceremonial gravity.

Floating organic entities in flasks: dense core with dozens of spike-like protrusions that undulate like tentacles; movement appears deliberate/intelligent; color-shifts under red/UV (transparent to deep purple; sometimes crystalline under red); central mass pulsed rhythmically; tentacular spikes moved with synchronized patterns; when speared, spikes recoiled then wrapped around probe “as if embracing it.”

interactions.transaction_blocker: Dreamer refused/passsed the flask along due to a warning feeling; no external prevention described.

interactions.description: Entered a vast theater-like space with a very high/dark ceiling; saw enormous (~15 ft) puppet/colossus figures behind oversized synthesizers; puppets had intricate articulation, organic-mechanical design, surfaces shifting between flesh-like texture and artificial materials; later observed their painted patterns/symbols and UV-revealed phosphorescent layers.

entities_involved.description: Enormous puppet figures/colossi (~15 feet tall), intricately articulated; positioned behind oversized synthesizers; surfaces and joints show mixed organic/mechanical qualities; painted with patterns/symbols; phosphorescent paint revealed under UV.

interactions.description: Observed a diverse gathering crowd including children; children showed excitement/curiosity, pointed out construction details, moved close to the stage, swayed/moved with the music; adults varied, some self-conscious; 1-800 Club members found places in the crowd and appeared altered.

entities_involved.description: Audience crowd with varied ages; children scattered throughout; some adults/club members appeared in altered states.
Children approached towering figures with excitement/curiosity; pointed out subtle design/movement details; several near the stage; swayed and moved with music without self-consciousness.
“1-800 Club” members in the crowd, described as under the influence of the earlier living substance; expressions suggested they perceived additional layers.

interactions.description: Watched performance: puppets manipulated synthesizer controls with delicate accuracy; music ranged from deep bass felt in bones to crystalline highs that seemed to create visible patterns; sound described as a physical force reshaping space; visuals synchronized with music as phosphorescent patterns morphed across puppets under UV/theatrical lighting.

entities_involved.description: Performing giant puppet musicians operating oversized synthesizers; movements precise/fluid; visual patterns on bodies morphed under UV lighting.

extraction.extraction_notes: No explicit mall sub-locations (food court, stores) or cardinal directions were provided; ‘time’ is only indicated by sequence and ‘last night,’ not by time-of-day or time-flow effects.
